title: Recursion basics
learn: base case + recursive case, call stack, recursion tree, recursion vs iteration, cost of recursion (depth = space)
hook: Trees, graphs, backtracking and DP are all recursion underneath. If recursion clicks now, half of the later modules get easier.

explain.prompt: Explain recursion to an interviewer using Fibonacci: how it works, what the call stack does, and why the naive version is slow.
keyPoints: a recursive function solves a problem by calling itself on a smaller input
base case stops the recursion; without it → infinite recursion / stack overflow
each call waits on the call stack until its sub-calls return; stack depth = extra space
naive Fibonacci branches twice per call → O(2ⁿ) time because subproblems repeat
fix by memoization (cache results) or iterating bottom-up → O(n)
